title: alchemilla vulgaris subsp. plicata
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris subsp. plicata, commonly known as Lady's Mantle, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family, characterized by its distinctive leaves with wavy edges and white or pink flowers. The plant is valued for its various health benefits, including its ability to soothe and calm digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Lady's Mantle include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, which can help to reduce swelling, prevent infection, and tighten tissues. The bioactive constituents of Alchemilla vulgaris subsp. plicata include flavonoids, tannins, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
